|strategy=By Dan Holmes, Red 31

[[Black 4]]. Just another TIE that is no more useful than the others, right? Wrong! [[Black 4]] should be considered one of the best secret weapons that the Imperial Navy has.

Just imagine this. Both sides are playing space. You have [[Grand Moff Tarkin]] on [[Black 2]] alone at [[Kessel (Dark){{!}}Kessel]]. The Light Side plays [[Han Solo]] on the [[Millennium Falcon{{!}}Falcon]] and initiates a battle. Normally, [[Grand Moff Tarkin{{!}}Tarkin]] would get beaten up, but not today. Because he is on [[Black 2]], [[Black 4]]'s game text allows it to deploy with a pilot for free. So now [[Darth Vader{{!}}Vader]] comes out of nowhere against the [[Millennium Falcon{{!}}Falcon]] for a change. The tide of the battle has turned and the universe is one step closer to eliminating the Rebel threat.
|rulings=* To use the react text, you must have a piloted TIE there. It's even possible that other TIE was itself just deployed as a react a moment earlier.
* When using the react text to deploy for free, the pilot is also free.
* When using [[Black 4]]'s text to deploy it and a pilot for free, and Goldenrod on table, must use 2 Force for the pilot (but 0 for [[Black 4]]).
* Short Range Fighters & [[Watch Your Back!]]
* [[Reserve Pilot]]
* Imperial (starship)
